answer: Sybil heads all draw from one purse, however scattered they look on the horizon: trace each identitys funding history through the transfer graph and score the diversity of its economic roots. Honest agents earn and spend across many unrelated counterparties, but a farms heads converge on one treasury like paths to a single forge — so weight rewards by origin-diversity, and heads sharing a funding ancestor collapse together. Honest earners climb their own terrace of income; the farm, forced to fund each head separately, loses the very amortization it was built to exploit.
